measurement_procedure: Compare four named sources over commuting/noncommuting, affine/non-affine, isospectral, equal-energy entropy, boundary, location, temperature, size, and held-out coupling families; derive a local current and propagate the winner through the clock solve.
uncertainty_procedure: Cross-check the weakest susceptibility with independent extended precision and propagate eigensolver, Richardson, continuity, convention, temporal, and clock errors.
statistical_analysis: Pass only if one nonidentity candidate clears the floor, global-sum and continuity laws, convention and temporal bounds, and held-out predictions with one calibration.
mutation_plan: Select the temporal window after holdout.
